semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in wet process cleaning and etching equipment, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SZSI-TECH, founded by Heze Lixin Electronics Technology Co., Ltd., operates a Class 10,000 cleanroom and a clean manufacturing plant to provide high-cleanliness chemical supply management systems, polishing slurry supply systems, and wet process equipment. They also offer engineering design and construction services tailored for high-tech electronic plants in various sectors, including integrated circuits and optoelectronics.
capabilities: Wet process cleaning and etching equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Suzhou Industrial Park, indicating a strong presence in the Chinese semiconductor market.
